Our Board of Directors reserves the right, notwithstanding stockholder approval of this Proposal and without further stockholder action, to delay or abandon the amendment to our Restated Certificate of Incorporation and the Reverse Stock Split if, prior to filing such amendment, the Board of Directors determines in its sole discretion that the Reverse Stock Split is no longer in our best interests and the best interests of our stockholders.
If the Reverse Split Amendment has not been filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware within one year from the date of the Annual Meeting, the Board will abandon the Reverse Split Amendment.
Also, the Registrant reserves the right, in its discretion, to abandon the reverse stock split at any time prior to filing with the New York Secretary of State of the applicable amendment to its Restated Certificate of Incorporation.
No further action on the part of the shareholders would be required to either effect or abandon the reverse split.
Until no Notes or Preferred Shares remain outstanding, the Company shall not effect any stock combination, reverse stock split or other similar transaction (or make any public announcement or disclosure with respect to any of the foregoing) without the prior written consent of the Required Holders.
If the stockholders do not approve Proposal No. 3, the certificate of amendment to our certificate of incorporation will not be filed and we will not effectuate the Reverse Stock Split.
If the Certificate of Amendment effecting the Reverse Stock Split has not been filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware on or before December 31, 2018, our board of directors will be deemed to have abandoned the Reverse Stock Split.
In such case, we would not implement the Reverse Stock Split.
However, the Board will not implement a reverse split or a reduction in the number of authorized shares of Common Stock if it determines at any time that a reverse split would not be in the best interests of the Company.
